log_dataset.description:
If the dataset type is `LOGS`, this configuration defines the semantics for
the log dataset.

trace_dataset.description:
If the dataset type is `TRACES`, this configuration defines the semantics for
the trace dataset.

value.description: The value of the filter compared to the target trace or span field.

max.description: Maximum number of spans that must match a span query, inclusive.

min.description: Minimum number of spans that must match a span query, inclusive.

max_secs.description: Maximum duration, in seconds, required for a span or trace to match.

min_secs.description: Minimum duration, in seconds, required for a span or trace to match.

comparison.description: The comparison operation to apply to an input against the given query value.

value.description: The filter value used in comparison against match candidates.

span_scopes.description:
Specifies the span filters that define which spans contribute to the metrics calculation.
Only spans matching these filters will be included in the metrics aggregation.

duration.description: Matches the duration of the candidate span.

error.description: Matches the error status of the candidate span.

is_root_span.description:
Matches the root span of a trace. For example, if the parent span has no child
spans.

match_type.description:
If `INCLUDE`, includes all traces that have at least one (or `span_count`)
spans matching the query. If `EXCLUDE`, excludes all traces that have at least
one (or `span_count`) spans matching the query.

operation.description: Matches the operation of the candidate span.

parent_operation.description: If not a root span, matches the operation of the candidate span's parent span

parent_service.description: If not a root span, matches the service of the candidate span's parent span.

service.description: Matches the service of the candidate span.

span_count.description:
Defines the number of spans that must match the criteria defined by the span
query. Defaults to requiring that at least one span matches the span query.

tags.description: Matches the tags of the candidate span.

in_values.description: Values the filter tests against when using `IN` or `NOT_IN` match type.

match.description:
Specifies the comparison operator for the query. If `EXACT`, compared strings
must have the exact value of the query value.

value.description: The value of the filter compared to the target trace or span field.

key.description: The key or name of the span tag that this filter inspects.

numeric_value.description:
If the query matches the tag with the specified key, and the value type is
`numeric`, specifies the matcher used to evaluate the span tag value.

value.description:
If the query matches the tag with the specified key, and the value type is a
`string`, specifies the matcher used to evaluate the span tag value.

duration.description: Matches traces based on the duration of the entire trace.

error.description: Matches traces based on the top-level error status.

configuration.description: Required. Defines the configuration of the dataset.

created_at.description: Timestamp of when the Dataset was created. Cannot be set by clients.

name.description: The name of the Dataset. You can modify this value after the Dataset is created.

slug.description: The unique identifier of the Dataset. If a `slug` isn't provided, one is generated based on the `name` field. You can't modify this field after the Dataset is created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of when the Dataset was last updated. Cannot be set by clients.

match_criteria.description: Required. Defines the criteria to match logs to a dataset.

query.description:
Returns logs that match this query. The query can include only top-level
operations. Nested clauses aren't supported. Only one type of `AND` or `OR`
operator is allowed.

match_criteria.description: Required. Defines the criteria to match traces to a dataset.

scope_filter.description: Scope filter that defines which spans within matching traces contribute to metrics calculation.

span.description:
Specifies the span conditions to match on. All conditions must be true in a
single span for the span to be considered a match. If `span_count` is specified,
the number of spans within the trace that match span conditions must be within
`[min, max]`. You can specify multiple span conditions, and each can be
satisfied by any number of spans within the trace.

trace.description: Trace-level filter criteria (effectively matching the root span).
